svg.text: STAGE 392 · TOPIC 32 FAQ
WebRTC TWCC Audio-Priority Shedding & Burst-Loss PLC Hallucination Gate
DSCP EF (46) + <350kbps Video Shedding (P777) & <=60ms NetEQ PLC Anti-Hallucination + RFC 4585 NACK (P778)
1. WebRTC TWCC Audio-Priority & DSCP EF (46) Shedding (P777)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Video/Avatar Keyframes Starving 32kbps Voice RTP
• Equal-FIFO pacing sends 150KB video I-frames ahead of 60-byte Opus audio packets
• Sub-350kbps cellular link drops 40% of voice frames while trying to push video
• Result: Robotic unintelligible voice & 480ms head-of-line pacer queuing lag
✅ Production Pattern: DSCP EF (46) + <350kbps Video Drop (P777)
1. Strict Priority Queue: Tag audio RTP DSCP EF (46); dequeue before any video/data
2. Reserved Audio Floor: Carve out >=24–32kbps for Opus + LBRR FEC prior to BWE split
3. Instant Visual Shedding: Suspend avatar/screen video at 0ms when BWE < 350kbps
4. Unbroken Voice Continuity: Preserves MOS >= 3.9 even at 120kbps cellular BWE
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcTwccAudioPriority...):
minVideoSheddingBweKbps >= 350kbps && reservedAudioFloorKbps >= 24kbps
2. Burst-Loss PLC Anti-Hallucination & RFC 4585 NACK Gate (P778)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Neural PLC Synthesizing Fake Vowels Over 140ms Loss Burst
• 7-packet (140ms) LTE handover loss triggers aggressive neural PLC extrapolation
• ASR/S2S transcribes synthetic PLC formants as phantom digits ("Eight" / "Yes")
• Result: 17.2% phantom word hallucination on bursty wireless links
✅ Production Pattern: <=60ms PLC Cap + Gap Tag & RFC 4585 NACK (P778)
1. Strict PLC Extrapolation Cap: Limit unflagged NetEQ PLC synthesis to <=60ms (3 pkts)
2. Selective RFC 4585 NACK: Request audio packet retransmission when RTT <= 120ms
3. Explicit Masked-Gap Tagging: Mark >60ms loss with <plc_masked_gap/> for LLM
4. Zero Phantom Slot Writes: Cuts burst-loss ASR hallucinations from 17.2% to 0.0%
Deterministic Invariant (evaluatePacketLossBurstPlcAntiHallucination...):
maxUnflaggedPlcBurstMs <= 60ms && maxAudioNackRttMs <= 120ms
Stage 392 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (395 Dimensions · 787 Guardrails · 796 Probes · 834 Unit Tests)
• TWCC Audio Priority (P777): Preserves MOS >=3.9 at 120kbps; PLC Anti-Hallucination (P778): Cuts phantom words from 17.2% to 0.0%.
